d.ko: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler with 9 unique races, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique dungeons, a classless skill system, and extensive guild management system to master as you uncover the secrets of the world of Dragaea!
d.en: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler with 9 unique races, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique dungeons, a classless skill system, and extensive guild management system to master as you uncover the secrets of the world of Dragaea!
d.zh: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons 是一款第一人称放置类地下城探险游戏，拥有六大独特种族、丰富的战斗系统、横跨整片大陆的史诗剧情、无职业限制的技能体系，以及一个庞大的公会管理系统。随着你逐步揭开德拉盖亚世界的秘密，这一切都等待着你去掌控！
